text: This report provides information on the status of the Exhibition Place health and safety system, specifically on activities, priorities and performance during the first quarter of 2022. There were 0 lost time injuries and 1 medical aid injuries in Q1 2022 as compared to 0 lost time injuries and 0 medical aid injuries during the same period of 2021. Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) invoiced costs for Q1 2022 were approximately 31 percent lower to those in the same period of 2021. This is attributable decreased Long Term Disability costs and lower WSIB claim costs.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (May 26, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
